challengeDescription: Most small and medium businesses in India run on a patchwork of tools one for tasks, another for HR, a spreadsheet for leads, WhatsApp for everything else. Each new hire means another login, another subscription, another bill that grows faster than the team does. We built Bunch to break that pattern one flat price, however big your team gets.
challengePoints: You hired 5 more people, and the software bill jumped again.
Your team logs into six different apps just to get through one workday.
You find out an order's stuck only when the client calls to ask.
Payroll and attendance live in separate tools that never sync.
Nobody knows which leads are actually being followed up.

testimonials.quote: Payroll used to involve a lot of manual checking between attendance records and spreadsheets. With Bunch, our attendance and payroll workflows are connected, so the process is much cleaner. Our monthly payroll close is now around 40% faster, and HR spends considerably less time correcting attendance-related information.

We didn't need another complicated business platform. We needed something our team would actually use every day. Bunch has helped us bring sales, tasks, client information, and team operations into one system. It has made it much easier for me to see what's happening across the business without chasing updates.

Our biggest headache wasn't the amount of work it was keeping track of where everything stood. A client would call and we'd sometimes have to check email, WhatsApp, and a spreadsheet before we could answer properly. Bunch has given us one place to look. I can now see the client, related tasks, and follow-ups without asking three different people for an update.

Events are never as simple as they look from the outside. There are vendors to coordinate, client requests coming in, deadlines moving around, and a hundred small tasks that can easily get forgotten. We started using Bunch to bring all of that into one workflow. What I like most is that my team can see what they own and what's coming next without me having to keep checking in with everyone.

Before Bunch, our client work was spread across our CRM, spreadsheets, project tools and team chats. We moved our leads, clients and project tasks into Bunch, and the difference was immediate. Our team now spends around 4–5 fewer hours each week chasing updates, and I can see what's happening across our projects without asking for separate reports.

I wasn't looking for another dashboard. I needed fewer questions coming to my desk. With Bunch, I can check the status of orders and tasks myself instead of waiting for someone to send me an update. Bunzo AI has been particularly useful when I need a quick answer- I can ask the question directly rather than digging through records.

Our HR team was spending too much time maintaining information in different places. Attendance was one system, employee details another, and payroll involved a lot of checking in between. Bunch has brought those processes much closer together. The monthly payroll routine is easier to manage now, and the team has fewer manual checks to deal with.

What I appreciate about Bunch is that it doesn't require us to constantly think about the software. The team logs in, checks their work, updates what they need to update, and gets on with the day. I can still see what's happening without being involved in every small task. That's probably been the most useful part for us.

We initially looked at Bunch because we wanted to reduce the number of tools our team was using. What stood out was that CRM, tasks, HR and payroll could sit under the same platform. We now have 25+ team members working from the same system without having to manage separate software accounts for every function. It has made our day-to-day operations noticeably easier.

faqDescription: Clear answers, before you get started.

faqs.question: What is Bunch and who is it built for?
faqs.answer: Bunch is an all-in-one business platform for small and growing businesses. It combines CRM, sales, HRMS, task management, payroll, attendance, orders, team communication, and AI in one workspace.

faqs.question: What can I manage with Bunch?
faqs.answer: You can manage leads, clients, tasks, employees, attendance, payroll, orders, and team activity from one workspace. Bunch also includes dashboards, permissions, multiple task views, and Bunzo AI.

faqs.question: Is Bunch really unlimited users?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bunch supports unlimited users on its core subscription, so you can add team members without increasing the base price based on user count.

faqs.question: What is included in the Bunch subscription?
faqs.answer: All 5 core modules are included for every user from day one. This includes CRM, leads, clients, tasks, HRMS, payroll, attendance, orders, live chat, dashboard, AI, and permissions.

faqs.question: How much does Bunch cost?
faqs.answer: Bunch costs ₹4,900/month, excluding GST, with unlimited users and all 12 core modules included. A yearly plan is also available at ₹49,980/year.

faqs.question: What does Bunzo AI actually do?
faqs.answer: Bunzo AI works with information in your Bunch workspace, including tasks, leads, clients, and orders. You can ask questions in plain language and get answers or turn the next step into a task.

faqs.question: Can I migrate my existing leads and client data to Bunch?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can bring existing lead and client information into Bunch when you get started, making it easier to move away from spreadsheets or another CRM.

faqs.question: What if I need something that isn't included?
faqs.answer: Bunch includes all 5 core modules in the main subscription. Additional requirements can be handled through available add-ons and integrations where applicable.
